whenBuiltinStructuresAreInsufficient: one LKL 2 Knowledge Package that references the imported custom template

lkl2StructureSource.purpose: in-app editing of one existing structure instance or built-in template defaults

geometryGrammar.canonicalSerialization: operand is emitted when operandRefs exists; legacy point is preserved when only pointRefs exists

constraints.area: at least one operand; point-only areas require at least three points
constraints.volume: at least one operand; point-only volumes require at least four points

placementRules.construct: owns the target in the semantic containment graph
placementRules.structureContainerPath: required to materialize a target inside a structure container

validationConstraints.stableIds: all compiled top-level objects require package-unique stable IDs
validationConstraints.references: typed and container references must resolve to an object of the declared type
validationConstraints.templates: structure-instance using must resolve to a builtin, package, or installed template
validationConstraints.geometry: kind, arity, namespace resolution, and non-recursive geometry references are validated
validationConstraints.modulus: builtin:mod-n modulus must be an integer from 2 through 64

strategies.merge: update explicitly supplied fields while preserving local identity
strategies.replace: replace the same package namespace after confirmation
strategies.copy: create a new namespace and remap internal references

allowed: create knowledge, content, structures, variables, relations, views, placements, entries and source metadata
conditional: quote or adapt third-party material only when rights permit
use personal data only with user authority and applicable-law compliance
use custom factory IDs only when the target runtime already implements them
prohibited: invent sources, quotations or empirical support
emit executable JavaScript or dynamic eval rules
claim traditional or speculative systems are scientifically validated without evidence
create new board or frame declarations
claim a structure-source fragment is a complete package
